emotional_tone: Warm, trusting, and empathetic, balanced with high-density data efficiency. Soft medical aesthetic.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid for dashboards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6. Dense but clear.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-6 to p-8 for main cards. For data tables, use p-2 or p-3 to maintain density.
layout_and_spacing.radii: rounded-2xl for outer containers, rounded-xl or rounded-lg for internal elements to reflect the 'rounded friendly shapes' brand requirement.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. Avoid glassmorphism for this medical CRM; use solid surfaces to prevent visual refraction of data.
visual_enhancers.motion: Subtle hover states (-translate-y-[2px], shadow-md). Transitions on buttons and table rows.

icons: @phosphor-icons/react (best for dense dashboards and developer tools)

components.AppShell: Sidebar with active state highlighted via soft blue/violet background and primary text color. Topbar with global search and user profile.
components.DataTable: Dense layout. Sticky headers. Expandable rows or column toggles. Sortable headers. Hover effects on rows.
components.Cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift and shadow.
components.Badges/Chips: Soft tinted backgrounds (e.g., bg-blue-50 text-blue-700) for lead stages and tags. Fully rounded (rounded-full).
components.Buttons: Primary: solid bg-[#4A90E2] hover:bg-[#357ABD] text-white. Secondary: border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50.
components.AI_Hooks: Floating 'AI Brain' chat button. Inline AI insight panels with soft violet gradients and a sparkle icon.

logo.description: HomeIVF Brand Logo (Use in sidebar header and login screen)

avatars.description: Placeholder Avatar for user profiles and leaderboard

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary buttons is pure white. Muted text must meet 4.5:1 ratio on slate-50.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Nunito and Figtree fonts from Google Fonts.
Ensure 'Powered by TagQuest' text is visible in the sidebar footer and login page.
Build the dashboard with Shadcn UI components but heavily customize the appearance: use dense variants of tables and forms.
Lead detail page MUST be a two-column layout: Left for fields/stepper, Right for chatter timeline.
Filter bar in Leads should replicate Odoo functionality (multi-select, tags).
Embed placeholders for Phase 2 AI insights (e.g., an 'AI Summary' card on Lead Detail).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Do not use generic Inter font. Do not use dark mode. Stick to the soft medical aesthetic.
